pages.homeDescription: Enter free blitz tournaments, play with a friend on one device, or solve a puzzle.
pages.cupDetail: Join a free 5+0 chess tournament and follow the match schedule.
pages.hotseatDetail: Two players take turns on the same screen.
pages.hotseatDescription: Two players take turns. Each gets five minutes with no increment. No wallet is needed.
pages.practiceDetail: Find checkmate in a short exercise.
pages.practiceDescription: Try today’s puzzle or pick another one. The board responds after each move.
pages.cupPageDescription: Entry is free and there are no stakes. Sponsors fund prizes with test tokens. Use a wallet to register, verify matches, and claim prizes. Transactions incur network fees.
pages.guideDescription: 5+0 chess tournaments with no stakes and sponsor-funded prizes in test tokens.
pages.signUpDetail: Connect your wallet on {network}, open the tournament, and read the rules before registering. Entry is free. The registration transaction incurs a network fee.
pages.playMatchDetail: Open the match on the organizer’s schedule and sign to join the board. Joining the board and making moves require no transactions.
pages.reportDetail: One player submits the relay-signed result. The referee checks the record, approves the result, and resolves appeals before closing the tournament.
pages.claimDetail: After prizes are finalized, check your wallet’s allocation and claim within 30 days. Unclaimed tokens are returned to sponsors in proportion to their contributions.
pages.profileDescription: View a wallet’s Cup Elo, titles, and match records.
pages.organizeDescription: Set the schedule, publish the rules, and choose a referee.
